title: declared_kind_check.sh re-reads AT rows without checking jq's status
body:
`declared_kind_check.sh` (about :139-148) re-reads AT rows with jq without checking its exit status, so a row it cannot read is no row.

Expected: the rows come through lib_at_canon's reader, or jq's status is checked.

Found by ST0096's close-time catch-up critics (vc, 2026-11-22, refs/bank/vc/st0096/close-H4-critic-shell-guards-20261122). Fixed under hv decision 86 for 3.5.1, dc's unit d86d.
